points.title: that 引导名词性从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: That she was late made everyone uneasy.
examples.zh: 她迟到让大家都很不安。（that 从句作主语）

examples.t: I believe that honesty always pays off.
examples.zh: 我相信诚实总有回报。（that 从句作宾语）

examples.t: The trouble is that we have no money left.
examples.hl: that we have no money left
examples.zh: 问题是我们没钱了。（that 从句作表语）

points.note_label: 辨析 · that 与 what
points.note: that 引导名词性从句时只起连接作用，在从句中不作成分；what 则要在从句里充当主语或宾语，相当于 the thing(s) that，二者不能互换。

points.title: wh- 引导名词性从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: What surprises me is his calm.
examples.zh: 让我惊讶的是他的镇定。（主语从句）

examples.t: I don't know where he has gone.
examples.zh: 我不知道他去了哪里。（宾语从句）

examples.t: That is why I called you.
examples.zh: 这就是我打电话给你的原因。（表语从句）

points.note_label: 辨析 · wh- 从句的语序
points.note: wh- 从句一律用陈述语序，即使主句是疑问句也不例外：Do you know where he is? 而非 where is he。

points.title: 同位语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: The news that the team had won spread fast.
examples.zh: 球队获胜的消息迅速传开。

examples.t: I have no idea when the meeting will end.
examples.zh: 我不知道会议何时结束。

examples.t: The fact that he lied shocked us all.
examples.zh: 他撒谎这一事实让我们都很震惊。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 同位语从句与定语从句
points.note: 同位语从句解释前面名词的内容，that 不作成分且不可省；定语从句修饰名词，that 须在从句中充当主语或宾语。

points.title: 宾语从句的时态呼应
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: He said that he was busy that day.
examples.zh: 他说他那天很忙。

examples.t: She told me she had finished the report.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她已经完成了报告。

examples.t: He asked whether I would join them.
examples.zh: 他问我是否会加入他们。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 客观真理不变
points.note: 主句为过去时，从句一般退一步用过去时态；但若从句是客观真理、格言或习惯，仍用一般现在时：The teacher said the earth moves around the sun。

points.title: 限制性定语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: 关系词 + 从句（不加逗号）

examples.t: The man who called you is my uncle.
examples.zh: 给你打电话的那个人是我叔叔。

examples.t: This is the book that changed my life.
examples.zh: 这就是改变了我一生的那本书。

examples.t: Anyone who breaks the rule will be fined.
examples.zh: 任何违规的人都会被罚款。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 限制性 vs 非限制性
points.note: 限制性从句是必不可少的限定信息，缺了句子意思不完整；它与先行词之间不加逗号，关系词作宾语时可省略。

points.title: 非限制性定语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: My brother, who lives in Beijing, is a doctor.
examples.zh: 我哥哥住在北京，是名医生。

examples.t: The team, which was founded in 1990, has won many titles.
examples.zh: 该队成立于 1990 年，赢得过许多冠军。

examples.t: He failed the exam, which surprised nobody.
examples.zh: 他考试没过，这没人感到意外。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 只能用非限制性
points.note: 非限制性从句用逗号隔开，只作补充说明；此时不能用 that，which 还可指代整个主句。

points.title: 关系代词 that / which
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: The letter that arrived today is for you.
examples.zh: 今天到的那封信是给你的。

examples.t: Anything that can go wrong will go wrong.
examples.zh: 凡是可能出错的终将出错。

examples.t: The house which they bought is huge.
examples.zh: 他们买的那栋房子很大。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 只用 that 的场合
points.note: 先行词被 all / every / no / only 或序数词、最高级修饰，或先行词既有人又有物时，多用 that；介词后则只能用 which。

points.title: 关系代词 who / whom / whose
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: The girl who won the prize is my cousin.
examples.zh: 获奖的那个女孩是我表妹。

examples.t: The professor whom we invited gave a talk.
examples.zh: 我们邀请的那位教授做了一场讲座。

examples.t: The writer whose novel topped the list is young.
examples.zh: 那位小说登顶榜单的作家很年轻。

points.note_label: 辨析 · who 还是 whom
points.note: who 作主语，whom 作宾语（口语中常用 who 代替）；whose 表示所属关系，后接名词。

points.title: 关系副词 when / where / why
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: I still remember the day when we first met.
examples.zh: 我仍记得我们初次见面的那天。

examples.t: This is the village where I grew up.
examples.zh: 这就是我长大的村庄。

examples.t: Tell me the reason why you were absent.
examples.zh: 告诉我你缺席的原因。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 关系副词与关系代词
points.note: 关系副词在从句中作状语，先行词分别是时间、地点、原因名词；若先行词在从句中作主语或宾语，则要用 which / that。

points.title: 介词 + which / whom
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: The house in which he lived is now a museum.
examples.zh: 他住过的那栋房子现在是博物馆。

examples.t: The people with whom we worked were friendly.
examples.zh: 和我们共事的人很友好。

examples.t: This is the topic about which we argued.
examples.zh: 这就是我们争论的话题。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 介词的位置
points.note: 正式书面语把介词提到关系词前，只能用 which / whom，不能用 that / who；口语里介词可留在句末：the house which he lived in。

points.title: 时间状语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: when / while / before / after / until / as soon as

examples.t: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
examples.zh: 我一到就给你打电话。

examples.t: While I was reading, he was cooking.
examples.zh: 我读书时他在做饭。

examples.t: Wait here until the rain stops.
examples.zh: 在这儿等到雨停。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 主将从现
points.note: 时间状语从句中表示将来时用一般现在时代替一般将来时（主将从现）；表示「一……就」的 as soon as 同理。

points.title: 原因状语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: He stayed home because he felt ill.
examples.zh: 他因为不舒服待在家里。

examples.t: Since you are here, let's begin.
examples.zh: 既然你来了，我们开始吧。

examples.t: Now that the rain has stopped, we can go.
examples.hl: Now that the rain has stopped
examples.zh: 既然雨停了，我们可以走了。

points.note_label: 辨析 · because 与 so
points.note: 汉语「因为……所以……」在英语里 because 与 so 不能同时出现，只能用一个；because 语气最强，回答 why 时只能用 because。

points.title: 条件状语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: if / unless / as long as / provided that

examples.t: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就取消旅行。

examples.t: You can't succeed unless you keep trying.
examples.zh: 除非你不断尝试，否则不会成功。

examples.t: As long as you book early, you'll get a seat.
examples.hl: As long as you book early
examples.zh: 只要你早点订，就能有座位。

points.note_label: 辨析 · unless 与 if not
points.note: unless 相当于 if … not，但语气更强，常含「除非」的警告意味；条件从句同样遵循主将从现。

points.title: 让步状语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: although / though / even if / no matter how

examples.t: Although he was tired, he kept working.
examples.zh: 尽管累，他还是继续工作。

examples.t: No matter how hard I try, I can't please him.
examples.hl: No matter how hard I try
examples.zh: 无论我多努力，都无法让他满意。

examples.t: Even if you apologize, she may not forgive you.
examples.zh: 即使你道歉，她也许还是不会原谅你。

points.note_label: 辨析 · although 与 but
points.note: although / though 与 but 不能连用；even if 表假设让步，even though 表事实让步。

points.title: 目的 · 结果 · 方式状语从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: He spoke slowly so that everyone could follow.
examples.zh: 他说得很慢，好让每个人都能跟上。

examples.t: It was so cold that the lake froze.
examples.hl: so cold that the lake froze
examples.zh: 天太冷了，湖都结冰了。

examples.t: Do as I say, not as I do.
examples.zh: 照我说的做，别照我做的做。

points.note_label: 辨析 · so that 与 so … that
points.note: so that 引导目的从句（常配 can / could / may）；so … that 引导结果从句，so 后接形容词或副词。

points.title: as / than 比较从句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: as … as / not so … as / than

examples.t: She works harder than I do.
examples.zh: 她工作比我努力。

examples.t: He is as tall as his father is.
examples.zh: 他和父亲一样高。

examples.t: The result was not so good as we had expected.
examples.zh: 结果不像我们预想的那么好。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 比较从句的省略
points.note: 比较从句常省略与主句重复的成分；than 后的从句用主格作主语，口语也常用宾格：She is taller than I / me。

points.title: if 虚拟 · 与现在相反
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: If I were you, I would apologize.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会道歉。

examples.t: If he knew the truth, he would be furious.
examples.zh: 他若知道真相会暴跳如雷。

examples.t: If I had time, I could help you.
examples.zh: 如果我有时间，我就能帮你。

points.note_label: 辨析 · was 还是 were
points.note: 虚拟条件句里 be 动词通常用 were（不论人称）：If I were rich…；主句常用 would / could / might + 动词原形。

points.title: if 虚拟 · 与过去相反
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: If I had known, I would have told you.
examples.zh: 如果我当时知道，我就会告诉你。

examples.t: If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the train.
examples.zh: 她要是早点出发就不会误车了。

examples.t: We could have won if we had tried harder.
examples.zh: 要是我们再努力些本可以赢的。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 遗憾的过去
points.note: 与过去相反用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would have + 过去分词，表达对已发生事情的遗憾。

points.title: if 虚拟 · 与将来相反
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: If + 主语 + should / were to do

examples.t: If it should rain tomorrow, the match would be put off.
examples.zh: 万一明天下雨，比赛就会推迟。

examples.t: If you were to leave now, you would catch the train.
examples.zh: 你要是现在动身，就能赶上火车。

examples.t: If he were to come, I would tell him.
examples.zh: 他要是来，我就告诉他。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 三种将来虚拟
points.note: 与将来相反可用 should + do、were to do 或过去式三种形式，可能性依次递减；were to 最书面、最不可能。

points.title: 混合虚拟条件句
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: 主语 + would + do（现在结果）

examples.t: If I had taken the medicine, I would feel better now.
examples.zh: 要是我当时吃了药，现在就会好受些。

examples.t: If he weren't so lazy, he would have passed.
examples.zh: 他要不是那么懒，本可以及格的。

examples.t: If you had followed my advice, you would be rich now.
examples.zh: 你要是听了我的建议，现在就很富有了。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 时间交错
points.note: 混合虚拟中条件与结果指向不同时间：从句与过去相反、主句与现在相反（或反之），注意 now 等时间标记。

points.title: wish 后的虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: 过去式 / had done / would do

examples.t: I wish I were taller.
examples.zh: 我真希望自己更高一些。

examples.t: She wishes she had studied harder.
examples.zh: 她真希望当初学习更用功。

examples.t: I wish it would stop raining.
examples.zh: 我真希望雨能停下来。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 三种 wish
points.note: wish 后：与现在相反用过去式，与过去相反用 had done，对将来的愿望或不满用 would do。

points.title: if only 的虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: 过去式 / had done / would do

examples.t: If only I had more time!
examples.hl: If only I had more time
examples.zh: 要是我有更多时间就好了！

examples.t: If only she had listened to me!
examples.zh: 她当初要是听我的就好了！

examples.t: If only the bus would come soon!
examples.zh: 真希望公交车快点来！

points.note_label: 辨析 · if only 与 wish
points.note: if only 与 wish 用法相同，但语气更强，句末常用感叹号，多表示强烈的遗憾或渴望。

points.title: would rather 后的虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: (that) 主语 + 过去式 / had done

examples.t: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone.
examples.zh: 我宁愿你别告诉任何人。

examples.t: I'd rather you had not said that.
examples.zh: 我宁愿你没说过那话。

examples.t: She would rather her son stayed at home.
examples.zh: 她宁愿儿子待在家里。

points.note_label: 辨析 · would rather 的两种用法
points.note: would rather 后接从句时用虚拟（现在或将来用过去式，过去用 had done）；若只是「宁愿做某事」，直接接动词原形：I'd rather stay。

points.title: as if / as though 的虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: He talks as if he knew everything.
examples.zh: 他说话的样子好像什么都懂。

examples.t: She looked as though she had seen a ghost.
examples.hl: as though she had seen a ghost
examples.zh: 她看上去像见了鬼似的。

examples.t: They treat me as if I were a child.
examples.hl: as if I were a child
examples.zh: 他们待我像待小孩一样。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 虚拟与事实
points.note: as if 后若与事实相反用虚拟（现在用过去式，过去用 had done）；若事情很可能为真，则用陈述语气：It looks as if it is going to rain。

points.title: 建议要求类动词后的 (should) do
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: The doctor suggested that he stay in bed.
examples.zh: 医生建议他卧床休息。

examples.t: They demanded that the rule be changed.
examples.zh: 他们要求修改这条规定。

examples.t: I insist that she should apologize.
examples.zh: 我坚持要她道歉。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 后接虚拟的动词
points.note: 一坚持（insist）、二命令（order）、三建议（suggest / advise / propose）、四要求（demand / require / request）后从句用 (should) + 动词原形，should 常省略。

points.title: It is time… 的虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: (that) 主语 + 过去式 / should do

examples.t: It's time you went to bed.
examples.zh: 你该去睡觉了。

examples.t: It is high time we took action.
examples.zh: 我们早该采取行动了。

examples.t: It's time she should find a job.
examples.zh: 她该找份工作了。

points.note_label: 辨析 · time 后的形式
points.note: It is time 后从句用过去式（或 should + do），表示「早该做某事」；high 起强调作用，不能换成其他词。

points.title: but for 的含蓄虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: If it were not for / had not been for

examples.t: But for your help, I would have failed.
examples.zh: 要不是你帮忙，我就失败了。

examples.t: But for the traffic, we would be there by now.
examples.zh: 要不是堵车，我们现在就到了。

examples.t: But for his encouragement, she couldn't have continued.
examples.zh: 要不是他的鼓励，她不可能继续下去。

points.note_label: 辨析 · but for 的时间
points.note: but for 相当于 if it were not for（现在）或 if it had not been for（过去），是含蓄虚拟，条件不写在从句里。

points.title: otherwise / or 的含蓄虚拟
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.
examples.zh: 快点，否则我们会误车。

examples.t: I was busy; otherwise I would have called you.
examples.hl: otherwise I would have called you
examples.zh: 我当时很忙，否则就给你打电话了。

examples.t: Study hard, or you will regret it.
examples.zh: 好好学习，否则你会后悔的。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 含蓄条件
points.note: otherwise 或 or 前常是一个陈述事实的句子，其后用 would (have) + do 表达与事实相反的结果，属于含蓄虚拟条件。

points.title: can / could
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: She can speak three languages.
examples.zh: 她会说三种语言。

examples.t: Could you help me for a moment?
examples.zh: 你能帮我一下吗？（委婉请求）

examples.t: It can get very cold here at night.
examples.zh: 这里夜里有时会很冷。（理论可能）

points.note_label: 辨析 · can 与 be able to
points.note: can 只有现在和过去，其他时态用 be able to；could 除表过去能力，还常用作委婉请求，语气比 can 更客气。

points.title: may / might
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: May I borrow your pen?
examples.zh: 我可以借你的笔吗？

examples.t: It may rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午可能下雨。

examples.t: She might have left already.
examples.zh: 她也许已经走了。

points.note_label: 辨析 · may 与 might
points.note: 两者都可表许可和可能，might 语气更不确定、更委婉；否定的允许用 mustn't / may not，不用 can't。

points.title: must / have to
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: You must wear a seatbelt.
examples.zh: 你必须系安全带。

examples.t: I have to finish this by Friday.
examples.zh: 我得在周五前完成这个。

examples.t: We had to leave early yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天我们不得不早点走。

points.note_label: 辨析 · must 与 have to
points.note: must 表说话人的主观义务，have to 表客观要求；只有 have to 能用于各种时态（had to、will have to）。

points.title: should / ought to
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: You should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 你应该去看医生。

examples.t: We ought to respect the rules.
examples.zh: 我们应当遵守规则。

examples.t: The train should arrive at six.
examples.zh: 火车应该六点到。（推测）

points.note_label: 辨析 · should 与 ought to
points.note: 两者含义相近，ought to 语气略正式、更强调义务；疑问和否定句中 ought 前可加 to：Ought we to go?

points.title: will / would
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: I will help you with the report.
examples.zh: 我会帮你完成报告。

examples.t: Would you please close the door?
examples.zh: 请你把门关上好吗？

examples.t: He would sit for hours, staring at the sea.
examples.zh: 他常常一坐几个小时，望着大海。

points.note_label: 辨析 · will 与 would
points.note: will 表意愿、决心或对将来的推测；would 是它的过去式，可表委婉请求或过去反复的习惯。

points.title: shall
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: Shall we take a taxi?
examples.zh: 我们打车好吗？

examples.t: Shall I open the window for you?
examples.zh: 要我帮你开窗吗？

examples.t: The tenant shall pay the rent monthly.
examples.zh: 承租人应按月支付租金。（规定）

points.note_label: 辨析 · shall 的用法
points.note: shall 与 I 或 we 连用可表提议或征求意见；在法律条文、规定中用于第二、三人称，表示强制义务。

points.title: need / dare
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

formula.t: 动词原形（多用于疑问、否定）

examples.t: You needn't worry about it.
examples.zh: 你不必为此担心。

examples.t: Need I say more?
examples.zh: 我还需要多说吗？

examples.t: He dare not tell the truth.
examples.zh: 他不敢说实话。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 情态还是实义
points.note: need 与 dare 作情态动词时只用于疑问句和否定句，后接动词原形；作实义动词时则用 do 变化：He doesn't dare to tell。

points.title: 情态动词表推测
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: He must be at home; the light is on.
examples.zh: 他一定在家，灯亮着。

examples.t: She may be waiting for us.
examples.zh: 她也许正在等我们。

examples.t: They can't be serious.
examples.zh: 他们不可能当真。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 推测的把握
points.note: 把握由大到小：must（一定）＞ should（按理应）＞ may（可能）＞ might / could（也许）；can't 表「不可能」，不用 mustn't 表否定推测。

points.title: 情态动词 + have done
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: He must have forgotten our appointment.
examples.zh: 他一定是忘了我们的约定。

examples.t: You should have told me earlier.
examples.zh: 你本该早点告诉我。（却没说）

examples.t: She could have taken the earlier train.
examples.zh: 她本来可以坐早班车。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 对过去的推测与责备
points.note: must have done 表肯定推测，can't have done 表否定推测；should / could / might have done 常表遗憾或责备（本该……却没有）。

points.title: used to / would
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: I used to walk to school every day.
examples.zh: 我过去每天步行上学。

examples.t: He would often fish by the river as a boy.
examples.zh: 他小时候常在河边钓鱼。

examples.t: There used to be a cinema here.
examples.zh: 这里以前有家电影院。

points.note_label: 辨析 · used to 与 would
points.note: used to 强调过去的状态或习惯（现在不再），可用于状态动词；would 只表过去反复的动作，不能用于状态。

points.title: 情态动词表许可与请求
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: Can I use your phone?
examples.zh: 我可以用你的电话吗？

examples.t: Could you possibly send it again?
examples.zh: 你能不能把那个再发一遍？

examples.t: Might I ask a question?
examples.zh: 我可以问个问题吗？（非常正式）

points.note_label: 辨析 · 委婉程度
points.note: 请求许可时 could / might 比 can / may 更委婉客气；回答仍用 can 或 may，不用 could / might：—Could I…? —Yes, you can。

points.title: mustn't / needn't / don't have to
points.formula_label: 句 式 公 式

examples.t: You mustn't smoke here.
examples.zh: 你禁止在这里吸烟。

examples.t: You needn't come so early.
examples.zh: 你不必来得这么早。

examples.t: We don't have to book a table.
examples.zh: 我们不必订位。

points.note_label: 辨析 · 禁止 ≠ 不必
points.note: mustn't 表「禁止」，needn't / don't have to 表「不必」，两者意思完全不同，答题时切勿混淆。
